digest.component_or_area: LLM fallback model instrumentation and tracing
propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one rebar OTel span with zero-based order and no duplication from instrument_all, parented to the single Agent model-request span via ambient OTel context
Every candidate span must carry provider-qualified model identity and an outcome from the closed set {returned, raised}, with usage recorded only when the SDK response exposes it
A raised candidate span reason must be sanitized through sanitize_diagnostic and contain no prompt, response, credential, endpoint, or unsanitized exception body
The bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade must be legible as a native attempt span raised then a prompted attempt span returned with zero change to the _pai_structured control flow

Candidate-span instrumentation must be best-effort: any exception in span emission or exporter is swallowed at the wrapper boundary, leaving result, RunUsage, and propagated exception identical to tracing-off
FallbackExceptionGroup order, resolution classification, RunUsage, UsageLimits, pricing, and JSONL must remain unchanged; tracing disabled must yield identical behavior to tracing enabled
